WITH major_member_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    maj.major_id,
    maj.department,
    COUNT(*) as member_count
  FROM member m
  INNER JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
  GROUP BY maj.major_id, maj.department
),
total_with_major AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
),
major_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    mmc.major_id,
    mmc.department,
    mmc.member_count,
    CAST(mmc.member_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_with_major) as share
  FROM major_member_counts mmc
),
dept_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    department,
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM major_shares
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT 
  ms.major_id,
  ms.department,
  ms.member_count,
  ROUND(ms.share, 4) as share,
  ROUND(ms.share - da.avg_share, 4) as difference
FROM major_shares ms
INNER JOIN dept_avg da ON ms.department = da.department
WHERE ms.share > da.avg_share
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
